name: cr700_2d_eldrazi_confluence_repeated_modes_resolve_in_printed_order
why: CR 700.2d / 608.2c: a mode chosen more than once is treated as appearing that many times in sequence, in printed order whatever the order picked; each instance has its own target. Picked exile-and-return (own Grizzly Bears), then +3/-3 on Air Elemental, then +3/-3 on the opponent's Grizzly Bears: both pumps resolve first, one on each creature, then the exile (repeated modes, onboarding stage 6)
expect_order: Grizzly Bears is moved to exile
Grizzly Bears is moved to the battlefield
